packageRules.description: Routine bumps ride one grouped PR (group:allNonMajor) that self-merges once CI is green, so a merge rebases at most the lockfile and major PRs instead of one branch per dependency; majors wait for a human.

The [build-system] hatchling pin is template-owned: it moves only with a template release paired with a publisher check (see the comment above the pin in pyproject.toml), so a bump here is drift from the template (#839).
